items.title: Strategy (MSTR) Shares Tumble for Sixth Straight Day to $86 as Bitcoin Slides
items.description: Bitcoin Magazine Strategy (MSTR) Shares Tumble for Sixth Straight Day to $86 as Bitcoin Slides Strategy shares fell 4.6% to $86.13 on Thursday, their sixth straight decline, as bitcoin dipped below $62,000. The company's 850,849 BTC are now worth about $11 billion less than it paid. This post Strategy (MSTR) Shares Tumble for Sixth Straight Day to $86 as Bitcoin Slides first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

items.title: Darius Dale: 2027 Should Be a “Great Year for Bitcoin” as Fed Rate Cuts Come
items.description: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Darius Dale: 2027 Should Be a “Great Year for Bitcoin” as Fed Rate Cuts Come Darius Dale, Founder & CEO of 42 Macro, joins BMTV to answer whether the Fed is making a policy mistake with a December rate hike priced in. This post Darius Dale: 2027 Should Be a “Great Year for Bitcoin” as Fed Rate Cuts Come first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .

items.title: SEC Charges Eight Colorado Firms in $37 Million Fake Crypto Platform Scam
items.description: Bitcoin Magazine SEC Charges Eight Colorado Firms in $37 Million Fake Crypto Platform Scam The SEC charged eight Colorado-based entities, likely run from overseas, with taking more than $37 million from U.S. investors through fake advisers, fake crypto trading platforms and fake SEC certificates. This post SEC Charges Eight Colorado Firms in $37 Million Fake Crypto Platform Scam first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

items.title: Institutions are Piling Into Bitcoin ETFs, Pushing Holdings to a Record
items.description: Bitcoin Magazine Institutions are Piling Into Bitcoin ETFs, Pushing Holdings to a Record Galaxy Research says 13F filers added 49,229 BTC through U.S. spot bitcoin ETPs in Q3, lifting institutional holdings to a record 356,491 BTC as Wells Fargo became the largest holder. This post Institutions are Piling Into Bitcoin ETFs, Pushing Holdings to a Record first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
